description: Search Nike.com, browse a curated catalog category, paste Nike search/category/product URLs, or fetch full product-page details by URL or style code.

attributeFilter.description: Keep only products carrying a specific Nike merchandising tag. Applies to search, category and URL modes.
attributeFilter.title: Featured attribute

category.description: Curated Nike catalog category to browse. Works in every supported country; pass several categories by using `startUrls` with category links instead.
category.title: Category (mode=browseCategory)

country.description: Nike storefront market for search, category browsing and non-prefixed URLs. Prices are returned in the marketplace's local currency.
country.title: Marketplace / country

filters.description: Optional Nike facet labels, exactly as shown in the site's filter panel. Use `Group: Value` for an exact group, e.g. `Sports: Running`, `Color: Black`, `Brand: Nike`, `Width: Wide`, `Size: 10`, or a bare value such as `Running`. Unknown labels are skipped with a log warning.
filters.title: Nike facet filters

gender.description: Filter to a single gender facet in search and pasted search URLs. Not supported by Nike's API for country=TH or TW; ignored there.
gender.title: Gender

includeAllColorways.description: By default only the representative colorway shown on Nike's grid is emitted per style. Enable to emit every available colorway as its own record, each with its own real price, color, image and product URL.
includeAllColorways.title: Include all colorways

includeProductDetails.description: For search, category and URL modes, fetch each listed product's detail page and add description, features, sizes, stock, images and all colorways. Adds one HTTP request per emitted record.
includeProductDetails.title: Add product-page details to listings

includeReviews.description: Add the product's rating, review count, AI review summary and the three most recent reviews. Applies to product details, or to listings when `includeProductDetails` is enabled.
includeReviews.title: Include review summary

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records across all queries, categories and URLs.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Drop products priced above this amount (current price, in the marketplace's currency).
maxPrice.title: Max price

minDiscount.description: Keep only products discounted by at least this percentage. 0 disables the filter.
minDiscount.title: Minimum discount %

minPrice.description: Drop products priced below this amount (current price, in the marketplace's currency).
minPrice.title: Min price

mode.description: What to fetch. `startUrls` auto-detects each pasted Nike search, category or product URL and overrides the other modes when provided.
enumTitles: Fetch full details by product URL or style code
Paste Nike search, category or product URLs
mode.title: Mode

onSaleOnly.description: Only emit products with an active discount.
onSaleOnly.title: On sale only

productType.description: Filter to a single Nike product type.
productType.title: Product type

productUrls.description: Full Nike.com product page URLs, e.g. `https://www.nike.com/t/air-force-1-07-mens-shoes-jBrhbr/CW2288-111`. `/u/` Nike By You URLs are accepted too.
productUrls.title: Product URLs (mode=productDetails)

searchQueries.description: One or more keywords, product names or style codes (e.g. `air max`, `dunk low`, `CW2288-111`). Used with mode=search.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

sortBy.description: Order results. Nike's public wall API has no reliable server-side sort, so the actor sorts the fetched records locally.
sortBy.title: Sort by

startUrls.description: Paste any nike.com search (`/w?q=...`), category (`/w/...`) or product (`/t/...` or `/u/...`) URLs. Locale-prefixed links such as `nike.com/gb/t/...` set the marketplace automatically. When supplied, these URLs override `mode`.

url.description: A nike.com search, category or product URL.
url.title: URL

startUrls.title: Nike search, category or product URLs

styleCodes.description: Nike style or style-color codes, e.g. `CW2288-111` or `CW2288`. The actor resolves each code to its Nike product page and returns full detail. For Nike By You products use the 10-digit style-color code (e.g. `6484638358`).
styleCodes.title: Style codes (mode=productDetails)

title: Nike Scraper Input
